clare: Heads-up - last pass on Wed drop-in logistics. Goals: 48h public replay, 3 social clips, and measure which registration CTA increases demo requests.
dan: Zoom set to cloud recording + auto-transcribe. I'll enable 'auto captioning' and assign a co-host to start recording.
nora: I'll modify registration page copy. Two CTAs: 'Attend Live' vs 'Get the Replay'. Also adding a hidden field hs_cta for tracking.
ben: Can we add a tiny experiment: variant CTA color (blue vs green) in addition to copy? We can use ?cta=attendlive&color=green. Might complicate attribution though.
clare: Let's keep it simple - copy only this round. Save color experiment for next event.
replay-bot: Recording received at s3://redwood-recordings/dropin/3743600001_dropin.mp4 ; clip job scheduled.
hubspot-bot: Form submits: 143 registrants. Mapping configured: cta -> hs_cta, utm -> hs_utm_source.
nora: Timeline: raw recording in S3 ~20m post-event, clips + captions by T+70m. We'll auto-generate summaries for social.
dan: I'll plant 4 manual markers during session to ensure clip fallback points. Markers: 00:05:12, 00:18:45, 00:29:00.
clare: Email cadence: confirm, 6h reminder, T+2h replay with clips. Include UTMs: utm_source=dropin_email, utm_campaign=spring-launch, utm_content={cta}.
ben: For HubSpot flows: tag hs_cta, if hs_cta==GetReplay -> send replay drip; else -> include in live attendee nurture. Also log event when replay_url populates.
replay-bot: Clips ready ETA T+75m. SRT packaged.
clare: QA slot at T+90m to check caption alignment and clip boundaries. @dan can you own?
dan: Yup, booked.
clare: Social - pick 3 sharp soundbites, add subtext and logo overlay. Need assets by T+6h.
ben: I'll route final clicks through hubspot to capture which clip CTAs convert to demo requests.
clare: Great. Final: reg page push 08:45 PDT, host briefing 09:30, event 10:00. Ping here if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
